_doc: GAMES-GRAPHICS §4 frame-time gate (tests/frametime.spec.ts). Tablet project (1180x820, pixel ratio 2), CPU slowed down by the CDP rate below, 10 s of play in the city per variant (noon, by the lake and the promenade). 'reference' = test config gfx 'base' (the look before GAMES-GRAPHICS), 'candidate' = the default «🎨 Γραφικά: Αυτόματα» (tier Β with its automatic fall-back to tier Α on a slow device, asserted by the test). Both run in the same test on the same machine, interleaved in segments (ref, cand, cand, ref, ...), so the relative gate does not depend on which CI machine runs it.
_minFrameRatio: candidate frames drawn in the 10 s >= reference frames x minFrameRatio: the frame callback time misses the drawing (raster) cost, the number of frames does not (tier Α first cut: 160 -> 84 in CI).
absoluteGate: only when the reference itself meets p95MaxMs on this machine; otherwise only the relative gate (candidate p95 <= reference p95 x (1 + maxGrowth))

baseline._doc: The «before» numbers of step 1 (no GAMES-GRAPHICS change yet: both variants run the same code), recorded for the record; the gate itself uses the reference measured in the same run.

local.machine: owner PC (Windows, other jobs running), 2026-11-16, one run
local.note: same code in both variants: the spread is software-rendering noise

ci.note: same code: +3 % is the run-to-run noise; 20 ms is not met before any change, so the gate is relative (+10 %)
